analysis.title: Research Unplugged: Music in the Air: AI, Live Music, Streaming & the Path Ahead
key_insights: This is a podcast cover note. The document text contains only the summary, speaker list, topic list, related research titles and disclosures. The discussion itself is not transcribed, so no analyst views beyond the summary are available.

GS says the music industry debate is shifting from streaming adoption to monetization. It expects the next decade to be driven by subscription pricing, improved ad-supported economics, and GenAI's impact across DSPs, labels, and rights holders.
GS's new industry growth forecast is +5.8% CAGR for 2025-35E.

Podcast topics: Music in the Air 10 years on, ad-supported vs. subscription streaming, music and advertising, music and AI, the live music landscape, music D2C, outlook for music labels, and favorite ideas.

Related GS research titles list a Spotify Q3'26 earnings review (Oct-22) saying management expresses confidence in the growth and margin path. A Tencent Music (TME) 3Q26 preview (Oct-14) cites organic subs growth under pressure, healthy non-subs, shareholder return protecting downside, and a Buy rating. An Oct-13 note initiates Europe's market leader EVDG.DE at Neutral.

market_movers.rationale: Only a related-research title (Oct-14, TME 3Q26 preview) carries the Buy rating. The podcast text gives no new view on TME.

sector_views.rationale: GS expects industry growth of +5.8% CAGR over 2025-35E, driven by subscription pricing, better ad-supported economics and GenAI effects. The text gives no explicit overweight or underweight call.

earnings_insights: Related research title (Oct-22): Spotify Q3'26 earnings review says progress was made on forward initiatives and management expressed confidence in the growth and margin path. No figures are given.
Related research title (Oct-14): TME 3Q26 preview says organic subs growth is under pressure, non-subs remains healthy, and shareholder return protects downside. No figures are given.
risk_factors: GenAI's impact across DSPs, labels and rights holders is named as a driver and uncertainty for the industry, with no detail in the text.
TME organic subscriber growth is under pressure, per the related-research title of Oct-14.
